versions.changelog:
Initial release connecting live ad spend, hot-SKU inventory, and supplier escalation during major sales.

- Monitors sell-through risk and flags low inventory during high-velocity promos.
- Auto-generates pre-order messaging and syncs ad/landing copy when stock drops below threshold.
- Provides supplier restock email templates and quick internal alert messages.
- Outputs a Markdown sync table aligning SKU-level stock and ad actions.
- Includes a T-24h pre-event checklist when relevant.
- Explicitly scopes triggers and exclusions to avoid unrelated inventory topics.
